contexts.text: A rainbow the circuit of the throne in aspect like an emerald () = their appearance also around the Lord... The Divine sphere which surrounds the Lord... when represented in the Heavens, appears... in the Natural Kingdom to be green like an emerald.
Leaves of silver, the edges of which were adorned with emeralds.

A rainbow the circuit of the throne in aspect like an emerald = the appearance of Divine truth in the Heavens around the Lord. A rainbow in aspect like an emerald = the appearance of Divine truth in its circumference... The reason the appearance was as of an emerald, was that it indicated the Last Judgment; for the colour of this stone is green, and green = truth obscured... When Divine truth is obscured, it appears of an emerald colour. It was the (former) Heaven upon which was to come the Judgment... that was obscured; hence it is that a rainbow is mentioned, and its circuit like an emerald.
